ledger.noteHeading: CVE record, advisory, and public finding are different labels
ledger.noteBody: A CVE is the public vulnerability record. A vendor may separately publish an advisory, and some findings are documented only in a patch or issue without a CVE. This ledger counts {cves} assigned records as CVE disclosures and keeps {fves} platform-masked disclosures (FVE) separate. Severity is never inferred from an identifier.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.shortBody: This is a static personal website with no contact forms and no accounts. It uses Google Analytics to count visits, which sets cookies in your browser. Apart from that measurement, I collect nothing from your visit and I never see your identity.
privacy.storesTheme: Your light/dark theme choice is saved in your browser's localStorage. It never leaves your device and you can clear it at any time through your browser settings.
privacy.storesGa: Google Analytics 4 (measurement ID G-KV41V41G5J) sets _ga cookies to tell repeat visits apart. It reports which pages were viewed, an approximate location derived from your IP address, and your device and browser type. I see only aggregate counts, never individual visitors. The data is processed by Google under the <policy>Google Privacy Policy</policy>.
privacy.storesOptOut: To opt out, block cookies for this site in your browser, use the <optout>Google Analytics opt-out add-on</optout>, or any content blocker. Nothing on this site requires the measurement to work.
privacy.hostingBody: The site is served by GitHub Pages. GitHub may log visitor IP addresses for security purposes, as described in the <github>GitHub Privacy Statement</github>. I do not have access to per-visitor data from this logging.
privacy.emailBody: The only way to contact me through this site is email (<mail></mail>). I use your address and message solely to reply, and I don't share them with anyone.
privacy.linksBody: Links to GitHub, LinkedIn, vulnerability registries, and other external sites are governed by those services' own privacy policies.

about.title: About Me
about.bio1: I'm Seungpyo Hong, a vulnerability researcher. I have found vulnerabilities across IoT, ICS, financial services and AI software.
about.bio2: These days I design and run my own LLM-driven pipeline to automate the search. I decide which targets and which parts of them to look at, and I report only the candidates I have reproduced myself and proven to have real impact. I want to go deeper into research on automating vulnerability analysis with LLMs.
